# VRAM Deployment Calculator

> Free static web calculator that estimates GPU VRAM requirements, a
> recommended hardware memory tier, and rough generation speed for AI model
> deployments — inference, LoRA / QLoRA fine-tuning, and full training across
> text-generation, embeddings, encoder-decoder, vision, multimodal,
> image-diffusion, video, audio, and tabular workloads. All calculations run
> in the browser; there is no backend and no data leaves the page.

Core equation: Required_GB = (Weights + Working_Memory + Training_State +
Runtime_Overhead) x Safety_Buffer, measured against a usable-VRAM target
(advertised capacity minus a driver / CUDA-context reserve).

## Usage

- [Calculator](/): the app itself; every input is mirrored into the URL query
  string, so results are shareable deep links (e.g.
  /?total-params=70&precision=16-bit&execution-mode=Inference)
- One-click presets: Llama 8B, Llama 70B, Mixtral 8x7B, Gemma 2 9B, SDXL

## Documentation

- [Project README](https://github.com/rxdt/ai_deployment_calculator#readme):
  supported workloads, the calculation model, and local development
- [Source repository](https://github.com/rxdt/ai_deployment_calculator):
  TypeScript source for the formulas (calculator-core, workload-memory) and
  the GPU hardware-tier data

## Notes

- Estimates are planning guidance; validate against the target runtime before
  buying hardware.
